verdict.rationale: Off-cycle payroll is a core question for a payroll product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows regular payroll runs ('Run payroll in as little as 30 seconds', one-click processing) and an API use case for job-costing check creation. Nothing documents running an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule. Regular-run and check-creation features are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.
